grammarFocus: 学术句子的主干、修饰关系与名词短语；被动表达。
title: IELTS Academic Writing Task 1: Process Diagram – How a University Listening Test is Produced
prompt: The diagram below shows the process by which a university produces a timed listening test for its academic English programme, from the initial planning stage to the final stage assessment. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant. Write at least 150 words.
instructions: 本题为学术类 Task 1 流程图练习。请先花约 3 分钟分析图中 8 个步骤的顺序、输入与输出，以及各阶段之间的衔接关系；写作时用一般现在时被动语态描述过程，并用恰当的连接词（first, next, then, after that, finally）体现顺序。注意比较不同阶段在耗时、参与人员或产出物上的差异（如图中标注）。所有场景与数据均为模拟，并非官方雅思试卷。不要表达个人观点或解释原因，只需客观描述和比较主要特征。建议写 170–190 词，并预留 2 分钟检查。

figure.title: Production of a Timed Listening Test for an Academic English Programme
steps: Step 1: Needs analysis – academic listening lecturers and programme coordinators identify target skills (e.g., lecture comprehension, note-taking) over 2 weeks.
Step 2: Test specification – a test blueprint is drafted, setting section numbers, timing (30 minutes) and task types; completed by 2 assessment specialists in 1 week.
Step 3: Item writing – 4 item writers produce 40 multiple-choice and matching questions based on the blueprint over 3 weeks.
Step 4: Editorial review – 2 senior editors check clarity, fairness and alignment with the specification; revisions take 1 week.
Step 5: Trial testing – the draft test is administered to 60 volunteer students in a 30-minute session; answer sheets are collected.
Step 6: Item analysis – a psychometrician analyses difficulty and discrimination indices over 1 week; problematic items are revised or replaced.
Step 7: Audio recording – 3 professional voice actors record the listening passages in a studio; recording and quality checks take 2 days.
Step 8: Stage assessment – the final test is assembled, formatted and approved by the programme board; it is then used in the end-of-stage assessment.
